description: The six tasks require analytical solutions; creative writing and other open-ended domains are outside the evidence.

name: english_text_only
description: Other languages and multimodal user or assistant utterances are not tested.

name: regular_context_only
description: The study is not a long-context stress test; most tasks fit within 8k and all within 20k tokens.

name: summary_model_exclusions
description: Phi-4 and OLMo-2-13B are excluded from Summary because of context limits.

name: api_reproducibility
description: Closed API models may be deprecated, preventing exact future reruns.

name: stochastic_reproducibility
description: Ten repetitions leave statistical variance; larger repetition budgets might reveal missed findings.

name: gradual_sharding_selection
description: Gradual sharding uses inherently complex eight-shard source instructions, limiting the two-turn generalization.

name: mechanism_identification
description: Mechanism analyses are observational and task-restricted; the paper often uses 'hypothesize' or 'likely' for causal explanations.

name: summary_metric_length_bias
description: Joint Score is recall-based and favors longer summaries; outputs above 300 words are truncated proportionally before evaluation.

name: translation_metric_scope
description: BLEU may not capture document-level nuances, weakening the translation scope test.

name: model scope
description: 所有正式 theorem 对象是 UHAT；softmax 与 average-hard attention 的 succinctness 未解决。

name: precision assumptions differ by result
description: UHAT upper bounds允许 arbitrary rational weights；RNN comparison 假设 fixed precision。

name: floating-point evaluation order
description: fixed-precision carry-over 依赖确定的 evaluation order；换序需重新核查 associativity-based identities。

name: worst-case counter dependence
description: EXPSPACE hardness 需要编码巨大 counters；无法编码该结构的 subclass 可能有更低 verification complexity。

name: learnability not established
description: succinct representability 不回答这些 UHAT 是否可学习；作者称经验结果 mixed。

name: state-space-model extension underformalized
description: abstract/intro 对 SSM 使用“by extension”，正文没有专门的 SSM 定义、size measure 或 corollary。

name: standalone limitations section
description: 没有独立 Limitations section；边界散布于 §1、footnote 3 和 §6。

name: functional identification rather than learning-trajectory reconstruction
description: Eq. (4) isolates functionally separable subspaces of the converged manifold; it conflates pretraining and fine-tuning contributions instead of reconstructing concept-specific historical perturbations.

name: concept dataset requirement
description: The method requires explicit target X+ and reference X− datasets, requiring human labels or domain knowledge.

name: retrospective-only estimation
description: The current framework cannot enter the training loop for online tracking or apply directly to streaming/incremental learning.

name: covariance storage at larger scale
description: Although it avoids O(Nd) activation storage, d×d covariances can become substantial at 8B–70B scale.

name: compute-accuracy trade-off
description: The main text states that Engram trails AltPO, NPO, and SimNPO on Overall and Privacy metrics, while using a one-pass gradient-free regime.

name: scope: bilinear two-player zero-sum theory
description: The theory targets bilinear two-player zero-sum games; Markov games are an unproved possible analogue.

name: assumption: unknown and potentially tiny mu threshold
description: The game-dependent threshold can be arbitrarily small in the worst case.

name: compute: one-sided guarantee requires two runs for a pair
description: Corollary 3.2 guarantees one player; a full pair requires two role-flipped runs.

name: assumption: no dilated AsymP-DGDA convergence proof
description: Global smoothness of the dilated regularizer is unavailable near the strategy-space boundary.

name: generality: empirical extensive-form scope
description: The extensive-form claim rests on five game instances and curves, not a general guarantee.

name: reproducibility: extensive-form uncertainty details
description: No seed count, repeat count, raw trajectory distribution, or error display is supplied for Figure 4.

name: PV oracle fallibility
description: 作者明确承认 text-only reasoner 可能产生 false negatives；保护项只在失败轨迹上缓解惩罚，不等于 oracle calibration。

name: Textual-grounding scope
description: 作者承认迷宫等视觉模式不能简单转成文本，并将论证范围收窄到 explicit multimodal reasoning/System 2。

name: Causal attribution ambiguity
description: 当 blindfolded proxy 自身推理失败时，PV 将失败归因给 perception；该误归因风险由方法讨论而非独立实验解决。

name: Benchmark and verifier scope
description: 主结果覆盖九个 benchmark cell，verifier 评估使用人工构造的 N=273 challenge set；未展示更广泛部署分布。

name: Seed and uncertainty reporting
description: PDF 未报告 MoCA 训练/评测 seed、主 benchmark 离散度、区间或主结果的统计检验；“significant”主要是叙述性形容。

name: No dedicated limitations section
description: 正文从 §4 Related Work 直接进入 p.9 Impact Statement/References，没有题为 Limitations 的章节；限制主要散落在 §2.3 和实验附录。

name: Ethics/deployment discussion
description: Impact Statement 仅以通用句说明没有需要特别强调的社会后果，未给出具体 deployment/ethics 分析。

name: complex reasoning generality
description: CAT-Q has severe degradation on math and code pilot tasks.

name: deployment kernels
description: Public 1.58-bit kernels are limited to BitNet models; diverse-model support remains under-optimized.

name: FP16 performance gap
description: The authors state room remains to reduce the gap to FP16, especially on complex reasoning.

name: reproducibility reporting
description: No random seeds, repeats or uncertainty summaries are reported.

name: Table B model identity
description: The visible Table B does not identify the evaluated model.

name: No dedicated technical limitations section
description: The paper has no Limitations heading; boundaries are distributed across implementation, future work, and impact discussion.

name: Compute boundary
description: Stage II is said to take approximately one day on eight GPUs; this is an implementation fact rather than a named limitation.

name: Generality evidence boundary
description: Training/benchmark discussion is Chinese-subtitle centered; other languages are presented qualitatively without per-language metrics.

name: Misuse
description: Impact Statement acknowledges potential misinformation use and proposes license stipulations.

name: positivity / sufficient variability
description: 要求每个 target realization 对 bias attributes 有 support；B 是 Y 的 deterministic function 时 observational debiasing 一般不可识别。

name: selective mediation
description: 部分 mediator 可携带稳定任务信号，需从 B 中移至 W_stable；默认将 mediator 当 bias 的范围有限。

name: unobserved confounding and proxies
description: 遗漏 Z-prime 时 criterion 无法保证绝对 causal stability；在 input 没有 valid proxy 的条件下只保证阻断 observed B paths。

name: SAM-theory dependence
description: §6 说明 theoretical guarantees fundamentally conditional on SAM assumptions。

name: observed bias labels
description: DISCO 属于 informed bias mitigation，需要训练时显式观察和标注 bias variables。

name: unconstrained deployment
description: fully unsupervised scenarios 被列为 future work，正文没有将其作为已解决能力。

name: demographic-label semantics
description: FairFace 的 labeled sex 与内部 gender 区分；原 race taxonomy 被拒绝并以 skin tone proxy 处理。

name: initial sDISCO implementation discrepancy
description: Appendix B 说明旧数学式与代码实现不一致，主文结果已更新；旧表保留作 transparency。

name: Training family
description: Training is exclusively on up-to-10-mode GMMs; targets far from GMMs require retraining or finetuning.

name: Rotation equivariance
description: Whitening gives exact translation/scaling but rotation invariance only approximately through augmentation.

name: Asymptotic consistency
description: The paper says DiScoFormer has no proven asymptotic guarantees.

name: Reproduction detail
description: Seeds, optimizer, learning rate, loss alpha and code URL are not present in the PDF.

name: Impact statement
description: The statement locates generic generative-model misuse but says no ethical concern is unique to this work.

name: Associative rather than causal structure
description: The paper explicitly states that causal constraints or Mendelian randomization are future extensions.

name: Linear observation model
description: The linear observation model preserves interpretability and closed-form CAVI updates, while nonlinear predictors remain future work.

name: No longitudinal pathway activation
description: Longitudinal EHR and time-varying pathway activation are not modeled.

name: High-dimensional genetic scaling
description: Scaling to high-dimensional genetic features may require stochastic or amortized VI.

name: Permutation symmetry and exact edge labels
description: Repulsion reduces redundancy but does not break permutation symmetry; claims rely on relabeling-stable quantities.

name: Structural discovery compute and memory
description: The UKB run uses 27.8 GB and 73.7 minutes of training, despite inference below 0.1 ms.

name: Real-world structural ground truth unavailable
description: The paper evaluates structure against ground truth in simulation because it is unavailable for real EHR; UKB structure is checked through PIPs, prediction, and cases.

name: Reproducibility details incomplete
description: The code URL is provided, but seeds, convergence thresholds, complete hyperparameters, and initialization count are absent from the PDF.

name: External validation
description: No external healthcare cohort or prospective validation appears in the PDF.

name: token-dependent equivalence
description: Exact update matches the next-token distribution for a specific history; free generation changes attention values and requires recomputation.

name: mechanistic versus algorithmic interpretation
description: A weight-difference representation does not establish that inference executes the derived learning algorithm.

name: architectural prerequisites
description: Output controllability is required; Appendix D proves the fixed-scale post-RMSNorm boundary.

name: low-precision numerical instability
description: Direct Δm division can be unstable near zero; bfloat16 base condition shows lower agreement.

name: global reusable patch
description: The paper explicitly says the derived changes do not yield a global update that absorbs context for every query.

name: reproducibility reporting
description: Seeds, denominators, hardware, runtime, image provenance, and code source are absent from the PDF.

name: Direct cumulative-error computation
description: The paper says direct Eq. (8) calculation has unacceptable complexity and lacks an explicit per-step error solution.

name: Jacobian approximation
description: Approximation 1 sets Jxt≈0; Appendix A frames it as a magnitude-based simplification with SDXL W4A4 checks rather than an exact equality.

name: m=1 derivation conditions
description: The upper-bound argument invokes timestep-independent bounded quantization error and a bounded Jacobian/Lipschitz condition.

name: Low-step performance boundary
description: Appendix G states improvement is constrained when steps are fewer than 3 because little error accumulates.

name: Dedicated limitations section
description: There is no separate limitations heading; Conclusion contains positive recap and no explicit boundary paragraph.

name: Uncertainty reporting
description: No repeated-run spread, seed list, confidence interval, hypothesis test, bootstrap, or multiple-comparison correction is supplied for the main tables.

name: Dense-regime computational cost
description: An exact dense decomposition requires a full-hypergrid linear system that becomes prohibitive in high dimension.

name: Sparse greedy-rank bottleneck
description: Sparse support reduces system size, but the greedy rank search becomes the dominant bottleneck.

name: Sparse-regime non-uniqueness
description: Rank-deficient dictionaries admit equivalent representations; selecting a meaningful decomposition remains an open criterion.

name: Continuous-input scope
description: Continuous domains are named as future work, not covered by the current exact categorical framework.

name: Repeated-run uncertainty reporting
description: No seed, repetitions, confidence intervals, or resampling procedure is reported for the numerical tables.

name: Code artifact availability
description: A supplementary code artifact is asserted but absent from this verified-preprint input set.

name: Synthetic-task scope
description: Conclusion explicitly limits the theory and evidence to synthetic tasks.

name: Restricted attention scope
description: Conclusion identifies restricted Transformer attention mechanisms as a limitation.

name: Real-data gap
description: Conclusion names real function-composition datasets and naturalistic workloads as future work.

name: NH mechanism gap
description: The NH separation is said not to be directly characterized by function composition.

name: Optimization sensitivity
description: Appendix distinguishes learnability effects from expressivity in the window and small-scale sweeps.

name: Hardware and runtime evidence
description: No hardware configuration, latency, throughput, or end-to-end memory measurement is reported for the experiments.

name: Cost-structure scope
description: Fused streaming requires the stated affine dot-product structure. Raw Euclidean distance and learned neural costs are outside the current path.

name: Small-n/high-d regime
description: Tensorized baselines can be competitive when n is small or d is high and the dense matrix fits memory; Table 10–11 show d=1024 reversals.

name: Low-epsilon conditioning
description: As epsilon decreases, sensitivity conditioning deteriorates, regularized HVP is used, and convergence needs more CG/Sinkhorn iterations.

name: Extreme rectangularity
description: Extreme aspect ratios expose too few row blocks and lower speedup.

name: HVP approximation
description: Damping and CG tolerance produce an approximate HVP; default parity errors are about 0.5 percent.

name: Hardware/generalization evidence
description: All reported experiments use one A100-80GB configuration; cross-GPU measurements are not present.

name: Uncertainty reporting
description: Timing means and selected medians/counts are given, while confidence intervals, standard deviations, and hypothesis tests are not reported.

name: Low-k occupancy
description: FlashSketch is most advantageous when A is dense and k≪d but large enough to saturate the GPU; low k limits speedups.

name: Large-κ input-read cost
description: Very large κ increases input reads and can limit speedups.

name: κ selection is empirical
description: The paper empirically chooses the Pareto-optimal κ and leaves an adaptive choice for future work.

name: Theory/implementation permutation mismatch
description: Theory assumes independent uniform permutations, while the kernel samples edge-disjoint distinct structured permutations with dependence between neighborhoods.

name: OSE scope
description: The authors do not prove direct guarantees for their Gram-matrix metric or downstream learning performance.

name: Statistical uncertainty reporting
description: The PDF reports timing means, geomeans, and LDS averages but no confidence interval, hypothesis test, multiple-comparison procedure, or random-seed count.

name: single_layer_scope
description: Formal analysis focuses on single-layer attention and does not capture layer interactions or multi-head structure.

name: missing_layernorm_and_extensions
description: LayerNorm effects and multi-layer/multi-head extensions are left for future work.

name: preliminary_empirical_support
description: Synthetic and small-scale natural-language experiments are described as preliminary support.

name: one_epoch_batch_variance
description: Real-world 1-epoch training has high batch-composition variance, and retraction may appear even for the most frequent tokens.

name: experimental_reproducibility_gap
description: Seeds, run count, hardware, full budget, code source, and a resolution of the π inconsistency are absent from the read version.

name: uniform finite precision
description: Assumption 4.3 uses a uniform grid although fp16 spacing changes with exponent；Appendix C.2 and G.2 give a refinement。

name: fully used ball and equal-volume cells
description: Section 4.1 identifies these as two crucial worst-case assumptions；Sections 5.2–5.3 relax them empirically。

name: arbitrary-prompt condition
description: Assumption 4.9 is explicitly called non-trivial；Appendix D supplies scaling intuition and Appendix E supplies a different elementary-operation condition。

name: cramming compute cost
description: 随着 m 增大，cramming 被称为 prohibitively expensive；论文因而用 copying task 间接检验 arbitrary-length prediction。

name: unmeasured arbitrary-length theorem and lower bounds
description: Section 7 将 Theorem 4.10 的 empirical evaluation 与 theoretical lower bounds 列为 future work。

name: statistical and optimization uncertainty
description: 20-target mean、sigmoid fits 与一套 optimizer hyperparameters 没有伴随 seeds、intervals、restarts 或 search-sensitivity 结果。

name: Additive-pricing scope
description: Analysis focuses on additive mechanisms; quality-based and multi-behavior contracts remain future work.

name: Plausibility verification infrastructure
description: Providers would only be forced to report plausible tokenizations if users can verify plausibility; TEE and ZKP are suggested, not implemented.

name: Heuristic and defense completeness
description: Algorithm 2 may not be the most sophisticated exploitation method; other defenses may exist.

name: Other provider misreporting
description: A proprietary provider can misreport next-token distributions or publish a tokenizer different from its internal one.

name: Verbosity remains exploitable
description: Pay-per-character does not stop a provider from increasing the character count by increasing model verbosity.

name: Evaluation coverage
description: Only open-weight Llama, Gemma, and Ministral models are evaluated; LMSYS prompts may not represent real-world prompt distribution.

name: Market-equilibrium scope
description: The model is a single-user/single-provider micro interaction; user choice and multi-provider competition require separate treatment.

name: Legal and reputational deterrence
description: Terms of service and reputation may constrain misreporting, although the paper argues strong incentives can still lead to breaches.

name: Language-dependent provider margin
description: A small number of pay-per-character outputs have negative margin, including lower-than-average characters-per-token non-English outputs.

name: alpha_requires_separate_policy
description: 每个 α 训练单独 policy，成本高且不保证细粒度 trade-off 控制。

name: alpha_and_expert_steering_instability
description: α=10 有 training instability；expert steering 进一步削弱 α controllability。

name: full_diffusion_not_optimal
description: BL=L policy 在中高 NFE 落后 BL=32，作者说 policies remain far from optimal。

name: domain_transfer_boundary
description: 数学 mixture 训练 policy 在 coding，特别是 HumanEval，未完整迁移。

name: padding_compute_waste
description: BL32-slow policy 在 EOS 后有时未并行 unmask padding，造成 wasted compute。

name: ethics_or_deployment_limitations
description: 未见独立 ethics、deployment 或 broader-impact limitations section。

name: small_discrete_primitive_set
description: 当前 formulation 假设 relatively small, discrete primitive set 与 short program length。

name: human_and_causal_semantics
description: reconstruction 归纳 primitive semantics，不保证对齐 human-interpretable concepts 或 causal factors。

name: deterministic_stopping
description: deterministic execution 与 reconstruction-based stopping 在 noise、ambiguity、partial observability 下可能脆弱。

name: synthetic_benchmark_scope
description: 实验限制在 controlled synthetic benchmarks。

name: scaling_cost
description: NEO sequential rollout 约两倍 training cost；NEO-S 的 budget 直接增加 cost。

name: Arithmetic_length_OOD
description: pure NEO 在 arithmetic long-horizon exact factorization 上很低，search 才显著改善。

name: deployment_and_ethics
description: Impact Statement 不针对 human subjects、personal data 或 automated decision-making；只给一般 ML misuse 提示。

name: Precomputed bounds
description: Requires Mi, ci, L and C; they may be unavailable or too loose.

name: Hyperparameter dependence
description: Performance depends on minibatch-size and estimator-variance hyperparameters.

name: Independent-data scope
description: Current algorithms are designed for independent-data likelihoods.

name: Unknown speedup mechanism
description: The source of reported empirical speedups remains unclear.

name: Fixed-step SGLD behavior
description: SGLD decreases MSE early and then plateaus, consistent with fixed-step-size bias.

name: No paper-specific societal impact
description: Impact Statement says no societal consequences need highlighting.

name: Binary-reward scope
description: The main framework currently assumes binary reward and does not directly extend to continuous/arbitrary rewards.

name: Zero-success gradient starvation
description: If no sampled rollout succeeds, the practical estimators give zero gradient for that task.
evidence_sections: 4.1 Empirical Gradient Estimator|M.1 Non-Zero Gradient Signal Analysis

name: Finite rollout approximation
description: Finite T approximates rather than equals the infinite ML expansion; practical baseline shifts unbiased truncation from N to N−1.

name: On-policy scope
description: Experiments intentionally use fully on-policy updates and leave off-policy PPO-style training for future work.

name: Baseline guarantee
description: The average-score baseline is empirically helpful but lacks a theoretical variance-reduction guarantee.
evidence_sections: 4.3 On-Policy Implementation|M.2 Policy Gradient Variance Analysis

name: Perfect-verifier condition on efficiency
description: Reported test-time scaling efficiency explicitly filters solutions with a perfect verifier.

name: Non-binary evidence scope
description: The non-binary extension has one initial modified-maze study; full theory and broader evaluation are future work.

name: local smoothness assumption
description: Appendix A uses a minimal first-order-optimization analysis and explicitly declines to claim global validity for large language models.

name: timing-study scope
description: Timing/weight experiments use the Starcoder mixture and only 70M/160M models.

name: future generality
description: The conclusion calls for tests at larger scales, broader domains, RL-based posttraining, and multi-stage curricula.

name: continued-pretraining timing confound
description: Compared starts differ because of data availability, so the continued-pretraining table does not isolate mixture weight from timing.

name: proxy-to-mechanism gap
description: Theory concerns gradient alignment, while experiments report token-level proximity and CKA rather than direct gradients.

name: uncertainty reporting
description: Tables are described as 5-seed averages, but no standard deviation, standard error, interval, or mean-comparison test is supplied on the reported pages.

name: deployment and data governance
description: The impact statement says there is no new data collection or deployment and asks practitioners to follow data-governance and copyright practices.

name: task and resolution scope
description: The work focuses on moderate-resolution image classification and standard architectures; transfer to higher-resolution, dense prediction and diverse backbones is unclear.

name: direct margin measurement
description: The margin-centric interpretation is optimization-oriented; robust-margin statistics and tail distributions are future work.

name: compute and implementation detail
description: LS-PGD gives a 1.4× speedup, but hardware, complete timing protocol and all defaults are not stated.

name: uncertainty and leakage
description: Five-run means are reported without seeds, dispersion, intervals, tests or leakage audit.

name: deployment and societal validation
description: No user/deployment study or privacy audit is performed; Impact Statement recommends such audits in real systems.

name: Computational cost
description: Algorithm 1 的 time complexity 随 D_max 指数增长；Section 7 以 UMDP NP-hardness 说明 polynomial-time algorithm unlikely。

name: Tabular finite-horizon scope
description: 正文主设置是 finite-horizon, time-homogeneous tabular MDP with finite S,A and known reward。
evidence_sections: 2.2. Markov Decision Process|2.2. Markov Decision Process

name: Delay-observation assumptions
description: Assumption 1 requires independent inter-arrival draws, clipped D_h, and known D_max; unknown P_delay case reveals original deltas only after an episode.

name: Generalization boundary
description: Theorem 5 is conditional on Assumption 2; the conclusion’s beyond-tabular language is not accompanied by non-tabular evidence.

name: Dedicated limitations section
description: 没有名为 Limitations 的独立模块；边界散见 preliminaries, problem setting, Section 7 and theorem conditions。

name: upfront gradient cost
description: Per-sample gradient computation is expensive, although authors say it is amortized across queries.

name: whole-video unit
description: Averaging a full video can dilute short motion-relevant intervals with static or redundant segments.

name: camera-only motion
description: Motion masks may overemphasize ego/camera movement; down-weighting is used but full disentanglement remains future work.

name: classifier-free guidance mismatch
description: CFG is not explicitly modeled, so training-time attribution may not capture inference-time dynamics.

name: base capability trade-offs
description: Targeted motion adaptation may trade off broader base-model capabilities.

name: main-body limitation disclosure
description: The formal limitation block is in Appendix G.2; abstract, introduction, and conclusion do not state limitations.

name: optimize 仅表示 improvement
description: 脚注撤回数学最优含义，故不能把 OMAC 表述成 optimal solver。

name: 缺少 optimization theory
description: 没有 landscape、收敛或 optimal configuration guarantee；作者留给 future work。

name: 训练计算成本
description: 每个 HumanEval 维度约 1,400 API calls；50% 子集约 $5，但评估可能有 variance。

name: 黑箱 actor 与 bias
description: Comparator 偶尔生成劣于 positive 的候选；全训练集重新评估后转作 negative，但未量化 bias。

name: 多维算法形态
description: 当前逐维迭代以稳定 contrastive reasoning；真正 simultaneous joint optimization 留作未来。

name: 集中式 MAS
description: 目标主要是 flat/sequential；centralized MAS 的 master-subordinate communication 需改造。

name: 功能组件覆盖
description: 实验主要是 prompt 和 in-context examples；memory/retrieval 尚无实验。

name: tool-use 范围
description: GAIA 提供额外结果；更复杂的 SWE-bench/tool interaction 留作未来。

name: 数据、模型与任务范围
description: 主结果集中于三基准和 GPT-3.5；跨模型结果仅 code，外推边界有限。

name: 伦理与社会影响
description: Impact Statement 写作者认为没有需要特别强调的社会后果，未提供单独伦理研究。

name: titled_limitations_section
description: No standalone Limitations, Broader Impact, Ethics, or deployment section appears before References.

name: frozen_optimizer_geometry
description: Muon freezes the Newton-Schulz operator and AdamW freezes RMS geometry for candidate scoring; these are stated assumptions rather than bounded approximations.

name: isotropic_hessian
description: The redundancy term replaces an intractable validation Hessian with Hval approximately I; no approximation-error study is shown.

name: proxy_definition_protocol
description: The retrieved Dproxy description and the validation-split proxy sentence leave the actual run-level proxy protocol under-specified.

name: repetition_and_hardware_reporting
description: The paper gives no training-run seed count, GPU model, GPT-2 world size, or variance estimate for main results.

name: mechanism_isolation
description: No direct raw-gradient-versus-preconditioned OPUS ablation isolates the central geometry claim.

name: failure_and_deployment_scope
description: No selection failure cases, deployment behavior, or ethical impact analysis is supplied; the conclusion only names future data mixtures.

name: method scope
description: PRISM is tailored to LoRA-style fixed-rank updates; other PEFT methods require their own intrinsic geometry.

name: runtime cost
description: Geometry-aware operations create runtime overhead, while Table 5 reports nearly unchanged peak memory.

name: task heterogeneity
description: PRISM is not best on SST-2, RTE, and AQuA in the primary table.

name: late clipping saturation
description: Factor-space saturation can flatten late gauge curves and reduce diagnostic interpretability.

name: attack evaluation
description: The PDF states a DP guarantee and impact expectation but has no empirical privacy-attack experiment.

name: Dark or low-quality inputs
description: 模型可能同时难以解释内容和执行有效 adjustment，导致 unsatisfactory edits。

name: Already high-quality inputs
description: 输入已经具有较高质量时，系统可能添加低价值变化，或直接拒绝编辑。

name: User-expectation mismatch
description: 技术上合理的 modifications 仍可能无法匹配 user expectations。

name: Default computational cost
description: 默认配置总处理时间约 470s，MCTS planner 为主要成本；简单图像可减少 simulations。

name: Incomplete empirical reproducibility protocol
description: 指定 PDF 没有给出 seeds、data split、training budget、完整 hardware、participant demographics、exact baseline versions 或 failure adjudication protocol。

name: Selection–measurement coupling
description: 系统用 evaluator 的最高 candidate score 选择下一状态，而 UGC Score 又作为最终 metric；论文未提供 hold-out evaluator 或独立 human metric。此处是基于方法和指标定义的测量边界。

name: Missing Appendix H prompt/memory details
description: §3 唯一把 prompt/memory history design 指向 Appendix H，但实际指定 PDF 只列 Appendix A–G；该组件细节无法从本 PDF 复现。

name: Cross-domain applicability remains future work
description: medical/scientific/artistic images只提出 deterministic editors、plugin interface、domain-specific reward/metric 等扩展方向，没有跨域实验。

name: placement_and_frequency_generalization
description: 性能收益依赖 placement/frequency 调参，未必直接迁移到 unseen domains。

name: high_diversity_subtle_anomalies
description: UCF-Crime 等 scene diversity 高或 anomaly cues subtle 的数据集稳定性较弱。

name: compute_complexity
description: disentanglement 增加 architectural complexity 和 computation overhead，可能限制 real-time/resource-constrained scalability。

name: high_resolution_generalization
description: privacy-unconstrained、high-resolution datasets 仍探索不足，resolution 与 anomaly characteristics 的关系留给 future work。

name: over_suppression
description: large k 或 high lambda_face 会过度移除 feature content，可能伤害 discriminative cues。

description: Impact Statement names misuse risk for systems optimizing harmful objectives and calls for responsible deployment.

name: no_dedicated_limitations_section
description: 没有 `Limitations` 标题；可见边界被放在 Future work、Appendix G.3/G.4 和 H.1。

name: future_SMC_target_choice
description: SMC 以 R 为 target；作者提出 adaptive target 或 trajectory loss 可能更具信息性。

name: flow_objective_and_corrector_scope
description: 作者把 alternatives to SubTB 和 Monte Carlo corrector schemes 留为 future work。

name: benchmark_generality
description: 作者承认 large portion focused on established low-dimensional diffusion benchmarks，并列出更广应用。

name: tempering_boundary
description: 过高 γ 稀释 weighting，过低 γ 可 mode collapse 或 instability。

name: compute_tradeoff
description: 小 L 通常较好，但会增加 partial-energy 的 R evaluation 成本。

name: ALDP_boundary
description: ALDP 无 gradient 的结果不完全满意，作者称仍有 substantial room for improvement。

name: societal_impact_detail
description: Impact Statement 说没有需特别强调的社会后果，未给出具体 ethics/deployment analysis。

name: architecture_scope
description: 只实验 dense models，未做 MoE；作者指出 MoE 的 weight/activation ratio 可能不同。

name: bitwidth_scope
description: 主要聚焦 W4A4，未建立 ternary 或其他 extremely-low-bit 的统一 law。

name: scale_scope
description: 最大主 scaling experiment 是 595M/100B；作者说增大 N 与 D 可能改善 extrapolation。

name: metric_scope
description: 以 smoothed training loss 作为 validation loss proxy；没有 downstream accuracy 结果。

name: unreported_reproducibility_dimensions
description: PDF 没有把 seed、重复次数、跨 dataset/architecture、吞吐/能耗实测或 code commit 列为作者 limitations；这些只能作为缺失项，不能归因给作者自我设限。

name: domain and failure coverage
description: 数据只覆盖 LIBERO、RoboTwin 和 AgileX 五项 real-world tasks；1k failures 未证明覆盖完整 OOD action space。
evidence_sections: 4.1 Experimental Setup|Appendix A.1 Detailed Task Descriptions

name: external VLM supervision
description: progress labels 由 SEED-1.5VL few-shot ICL 与 task-specific milestones 生成，intrinsic inference 仍依赖外部 VLM 的训练监督。
evidence_sections: 3.2.3 Discrete Progress Token for Automatic Success Detection|Appendix C VLM Supervision Details

name: statistical precision
description: 每 task 20/30 episodes 取均值，未给 seed、误差表达或 calibration analysis。

name: compute and throughput
description: 完整 trajectory 约 30–90 秒、1.5 秒/frame、单张 H800；未给基线同口径吞吐/训练总成本。

name: specification gap
description: action chunk 行尾出现 “at .” 且缺动作维度；history resolution 在主文与 appendix 不同。
evidence_sections: 3.2.1 Action Control via Unified Token Sequence|Appendix A.2 Model Implementation Details

name: formal theory and uncertainty
description: 无 theorem/lemma/proof、formal complexity、confidence/calibration analysis 或独立 Limitations 段落。

name: assumption_generality
description: 结论明确承认 rank-1 assumptions 不普遍成立，IFEval 复杂 instructions 超出 rank-1 表达能力。

name: argument_structure
description: IFEval 五类 instructions 需要 arguments，而单属性 steering setup 未建模；Table 8 只提供条件化边界。

name: success_conditioning
description: 训练依赖成功 prompt steering 的 positive/judge-filtered triplets，未测试失败 prompt 分布上的 replacement。

name: axbench_dimension_tradeoff
description: 2B AxBench 的 combined gain 与 relevance 下降同时出现。

name: coherence_tradeoff
description: IFEval 的 activation steering + prompting 提高 IF Acc. 但部分模型 Coher. 下降。

name: evaluation_scope
description: 只覆盖 text generation、指定 open LMs、Persona/IFEval/AxBench；没有 human evaluation、真实部署、长期交互或 adversarial evaluation。

name: statistics_and_compute_auditability
description: 未报告 seeds、variance/error bars、训练预算、硬件或显著性检验细节，尽管正文使用 significantly。

name: ethics_scope
description: 脚注承认 evil/hallucinating traits 可能有害，说明选择它们是因为 prior work；Impact Statement 未具体展开社会后果。

name: off_policy_staleness
description: Pipelined rollout/update introduces stale snapshots; longer horizons and larger rollout batches amplify staleness, importance-weight variance, and instability. Table 6 covers only three WebShop settings.

name: rft_tradeoff
description: More RFT epochs lower RFT loss but excessive RFT degrades intrinsic reasoning; authors cap RFT at no more than five epochs.

name: threshold_and_budget_dependence
description: TTI/TDS depend on α, ε, η, N, Lmin, Lmax, Bmax, and the geometric aggregation; only α has a displayed sensitivity sweep.
evidence_sections: 4.3. Turn-Level Dynamical Sampling|D.3. Sensitivity Analysis on α

name: model_task_scope
description: Evidence is limited to Qwen3 variants and three benchmark families; no non-Qwen model, human study, or real deployment is reported.

name: statistical_reporting
description: The ± notation, sample sizes, seed values, error-band construction, and Avg denominator are not defined in the PDF.

name: causal_identification
description: RFT, format penalty, memory context, hierarchical advantage, TTI, and TDS are used together; ablations do not identify a mediation path from M to reward.

name: complexity_and_cost
description: No formal time/space complexity, rollout latency, resampling overhead, or monetary cost is reported.

name: notation_collision
description: β is introduced as a turn discount in §4.4 and appears again as the KL coefficient in Eq. (8); Table 5 lists KL coefficient .01 without resolving whether symbols are shared.

name: visual_aliasing
description: s≈ϕ(o) 的唯一 phase 假设在 POMDP 的 back-and-forth motions 中会失效。

name: history_required
description: 准确区分同一画面的不同访问需要 history、loop counter 或 velocity；论文只提出 concatenated observation history，没有实证。

name: benchmark_scope
description: 主 benchmark 是 Meta-World scripted demonstrations；跨域只覆盖 3 个任务。

name: proxy_only_short_budget
description: 仅 proxy reward 在 200k frames 内无 success，表明主结果依赖 sparse success 组合。

name: missing_statistical_resolution
description: 无逐任务终点表、显著性检验或 effect decomposition；图中主要是均值和标准差。

name: manual_reward_mechanism_identification
description: 超过 Environment dense reward 的 pre-contact 解释没有单独反事实/中介实验。

name: benchmark_scale
description: The only dedicated main-text limitation says UniPercept-Bench is smaller than typical semantic-level benchmarks and may be expanded.

name: uncertainty_reporting
description: No seed-level variance, confidence interval, p-value, or multiple-comparison result accompanies the tables or figures.

name: human_alignment_validation
description: The paper describes expert/practitioner definitions and volunteers, but reports no inter-rater agreement, calibration, or external human-held-out test.

name: data_and_leakage_controls
description: No deduplication, train-test overlap, or leakage-control protocol is stated for the many source datasets.

name: compute_and_deployment
description: Hardware and training epochs are listed, but reward inference cost, latency, and deployment budget are not evaluated.

name: metric_calibration
description: Tables 6-8 provide model and dataset profiles without calibration to human preference or an external perceptual standard.

name: composite_reward_objective
description: The combined T2I reward has no formally defined utility that resolves trade-offs among IAA, IQA, and ISTA.

name: Parallel-learning theory
description: The paper lacks a full theory for when or why gradient-based training yields parallel improvement; Corollary 4.7 is characterized as a single, somewhat heavy-handed result.

name: Synthetic PCFG and model scope
description: Experiments use a small set of synthetic PCFGs and scaled-down decoder-only Transformers.

name: Ambiguity
description: All experimental CFGs are fully unambiguous, so multiple parse-tree effects are not covered.

name: Depth-cause identification
description: Deep-recursion failures do not distinguish representational limits from optimization barriers.

name: Other Chomsky classes
description: No matched comparison covers regular or mildly context-sensitive languages.

name: Grammar induction
description: The task of inferring a CFG underlying data is not explored.

name: Optimal pretraining window
description: The experiments are not exhaustive and leave open how to train a model to consistently reach the best optima; too little or too much pretraining may be problematic.

name: Feature localization by CKA
description: Linear CKA does not itself identify which specific features are shared.

name: Foundation-model inference latency
description: 端到端 real-time performance 受底层 foundation model latency 限制；resource-constrained edge devices 需要 quantization 或 distillation。

name: Mostly rigid-scene assumption
description: motion-aware partitioning 当前假设 scene mostly rigid；busy intersections 等大量 moving objects 可能污染 geometric priors。

name: Unbounded drift between loop closures
description: 延长 loop 间隔仍会积累 scale、rotation、translation drift；learned visual priors 不能保证 bounded global error，高精度 metric accuracy 需要 IMU 等辅助传感器。

name: Ethics or societal impact discussion
description: PDF 没有独立 ethics、societal impact 或 privacy 分析。

name: Standalone limitations section
description: No section titled Limitations or equivalent standalone methodological limitation discussion appears before references or in the appendix.

name: Scope to non-canonical ordering domains
description: The abstract and conclusion frame the claimed benefit around domains without a canonical left-to-right structure.

name: Fidelity–exploration trade-off
description: The paper states that IP trails FO-ARM/LSTM slightly on distributional metrics while achieving higher novelty.

name: Repetition and hardware disclosure
description: Random seeds, run count, hardware and wall-clock are not supplied in the read PDF.

name: Cardinal utilitarian and fixed-utility assumptions
description: Impact Statement limits the setup to cardinal utilitarian welfare and predetermined individualized values for correct/incorrect predictions.

name: Rational-agent assumption
description: Truthful-auction guarantee assumes agents know valuations and maximize utility; authors say rigorous bounded-rational guarantees need future work.

name: Theorem scope
description: Constant bound requires fixed lambda and constrained linear RRM assumptions; k-NN lower bound has label-noise/smoothness/fixed-k conditions.

name: Payment feasibility and ethics
description: Payments may be infeasible, socially undesirable, or ethical concerns in some domains.

name: Socioeconomic and group fairness
description: Monetary payments can exclude users and payment exposure may correlate with a social group.

name: Experimental reporting granularity
description: The paper states 5–100 trials but omits seeds, hardware, per-figure trial count, and uncertainty bands.

name: Feature-based value isolation
description: uncertain: WKHP is stated as excluded from x in the feature-value construction but appears in the listed features.

name: Causal attribution of AgentFLAN robustness
description: Authors explicitly call the AgentFLAN comparison correlational because they do not perform controlled ablations of its training design.

name: Low-discrimination environments
description: SQLGym and TextCraft have limited action spaces and strong task semantic anchoring; perturbations can expose smaller gaps.

name: Single-turn protocol boundary
description: Mind2Web and SQLGym are near single-turn in this protocol, giving fewer opportunities for compounding interface errors and recovery.

name: Uncertainty reporting
description: The paper's tables and epoch figures display point aggregates without seed count, error bars, interval estimates, or hypothesis tests.

name: Validation and checkpoint preservation
description: Appendix K reports val size=0 and no saved intermediate checkpoints, limiting the visible validation and post-hoc checkpoint audit trail.

name: Training implementation coverage
description: Exact coverage is uncertain: p.4 names Qwen3-8B/14B and Gemma3-4B/12B training, whereas Appendix K describes initialization from Qwen3-8B for all trajectory-SFT experiments.
